title: DevBox project template
description: template.json in each folder of a templates repository; used by the templates plugin to create new projects.

$schema.description: URL of this JSON Schema, for editor completion.

id.description: Template ID, unique within its repository.

description.description: Short description shown in the template list.

language.description: Main language or platform, e.g. node, java, dotnet, python or other; used for grouping and filtering.

params.description: Parameters by key; their values replace {{key}} placeholders in rendered files.

files.description: Which files of the template folder are copied and rendered. template.json itself is never copied.

include.description: Files to copy; missing means all files.

items.description: Glob relative to the template folder.

exclude.description: Files not to copy, applied after include.

items.description: Glob relative to the template folder.

render.description: Copied files in which {{key}} placeholders are replaced by parameter values; all others are copied unchanged.

items.description: Glob relative to the template folder.

hooks.description: Commands run in the new project folder.

postCreate.description: Commands run in order after the files were created.

items.description: Command as an exec-style array, no shell string.

requires.description: What must be present before the template can be used.

commands.description: Commands that must be found in PATH.

plugins.description: Plugins by ID with the version range each must satisfy.

additionalProperties.description: Version range of the required plugin.

field.description: Form field: a JSON Schema fragment for a setting, parameter, credential field or consumer option. Same closed keyword list as subschema, but label is required.

subschema.description: Closed list of JSON Schema keywords supported by SchemaForm. Used directly for nested values (array items, object properties), where label and help are optional.

help.description: Help text of the form field.

default.description: Default value. Not type-checked, because placeholders such as ${java.defaultVersion} are resolved before type checking.

advanced.description: Collapse the field under further options.

secret.description: Render as password field; never prefilled.

optionsFrom.description: Fills a selection from check data: <plugin>.<check>#<JSON Pointer>, with * for list items.

format.description: String format; path shows a placeholder preview.

pattern.description: Regular expression (RE2 and ECMAScript compatible) a string must match.

uniqueItems.description: Whether array items must be unique.

required.description: Object properties that must be present.

additionalProperties.description: Whether, or with which schema, further object properties are allowed.
